policy: The 20 primary analyses are navigation/grouping families. The 80 underlying entry points remain intact as subanalyses/workflows; no computational implementation is removed by this grouping.

families.name: Thomson Scattering
families.description: Navigation family only: optical Thomson measured-spectrum inference, microwave frequency-domain CTS inference, descriptive spectral-moment diagnostics, and downstream ne/Te radial-profile utilities remain separate workflows with distinct physical models and input contracts.

families.name: Langmuir & Electrostatic Probes
families.description: Langmuir I–V, ball-pen, Gundestrup/compound probes, ion-saturation current, potential arrays and probe-derived density fluctuations.

families.name: Electron Cyclotron Emission (ECE)
families.description: ECE spectral inference, resonance mapping and temperature-profile workflows.

families.name: Doppler & Charge-Exchange Spectroscopy
families.description: Doppler line-width inference, CXRS and related charge-exchange spectroscopy.

families.name: Molecular Spectroscopy
families.description: Molecular-band spectral analysis and molecular population/temperature fitting.

families.name: Magnetic Diagnostics & Equilibrium
families.description: Magnetic coils and probes, flux loops, Rogowski coils, polarimetry, poloidal flux and equilibrium reconstruction; includes Mirnov-based mode analysis.

families.name: Emission Spectroscopy
families.description: Visible/optical, VUV and hydrogen Balmer emission spectroscopy.

families.name: Interferometry & Reflectometry
families.description: Laser/microwave interferometry, reflectometry and refractive-index/ray-tracing support.

families.name: Bolometry & Radiation Tomography
families.description: Bolometry, fast bolometry and bolometric/Abel tomography workflows.

families.name: Imaging & IR Thermography
families.description: Visible and fast imaging, infrared thermography and strike-point/hot-spot tracking.

families.name: Neutron Diagnostics
families.description: Neutron yield monitoring, neutron spectrometry and neutron imaging/tomography.

families.name: Gamma-Ray Spectroscopy
families.description: Gamma-ray spectral diagnostics.

families.name: Fast-Particle Diagnostics
families.description: Neutral-particle analysis, FIDA, fast-ion loss and runaway-electron diagnostics.

families.name: Gas, Pressure & Fueling Diagnostics
families.description: Pressure gauges, residual-gas analysis, gas flow, neutral pressure/recycling and effective pumping speed.

families.name: Fluctuation, MHD & Transient Analysis
families.description: Multi-channel fluctuations, ELMs, sawteeth, disruptions, correlations and spectral transfer/coherence.

families.name: Transport, Confinement & Plasma Parameters
families.description: Particle transport/diffusion, energy confinement and balance, Greenwald reference and pressure/beta quantities.

families.name: Heating & Power Analysis
families.description: NBI, ECRH, ICRH, lower-hybrid and electron/ion heating-power analysis.

families.name: Plasma-Facing Components & Thermal Analysis
families.description: Embedded sensors, divertor heat flux, erosion/deposition, wall impurity/dust and thermal response.

families.name: X-Ray Diagnostics
families.description: X-ray spectroscopy, soft X-ray arrays and hard X-ray detector workflows.

families.name: Instrumentation & Measurement Support
families.description: A shared toolkit for wavelength calibration, calibration curves and uncertainty, instrumental line-shape/response characterization, noise floor and detection limits, sampling/aliasing audits, and channel synchronization. These are presented together as supporting tools, not as additional physical diagnostic families.
